items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: that's when I met the Will Mastin Trio.

ctx.x: And Lil Armstrong was gigging, and Charlie Green said she wanted to work. So Charlie Green bought her that band -- Stuff Smith's band. Stuff got a small band. Jonah Jones and all the guys was in that band. (Inaudible) Stuff Smith's band.
And the winter of '36, I went up to join her, and that's when I met the Will Mastin Trio.

Will Mastin and Sammy Davis' father was doing a duet. There was two of them together. They was in the show. I went to join -- the Vendome Hotel -- that's where the showplace was at. It was a place in Buffalo.
